headline: Rio Tinto Advances Lithium Direct Extraction Operations in Argentina
summary: Rio Tinto is scaling lithium brine extraction at the Salar del Hombre Muerto in Catamarca, utilizing direct extraction methods to yield lithium in days rather than months.
why: Rio Tinto's direct lithium extraction operations represent key capacity additions for the global EV battery material supply chain.

impacts.name: Rio Tinto
impacts.why: Expanding operational capacity at its Argentine lithium brine site.
